evidence: This is a terrain wall face strip (32px tall), which naturally presents as a vertical south wall face like the reference wall strips, with recessed metal panels, rivets, vents, and horizontal trim.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich plaster speckle and stone coursing of the Beodeul wall references, the candidate consists of large flat fills of a single slate-blue color (e.g. rows 8-18 in the panels, and rows 24-27 in the lower baseboard) with only a couple of stray 2-3px horizontal lines and corner rivets. Information density and surface texture are much lower than the reference standard.
